summary: Invisible anchor section for deep-linking and direct navigation to page sections.
features: Custom ID configuration for anchor targets
Copyable URL display for easy sharing
shortDescription: The Scroll Anchor Studio section places an invisible target element on the page that enables direct linking to specific content sections. When editors assign an ID, the studio displays a copyable URL containing the anchor hash. This allows marketing teams to share links that jump directly to promotions, product features, or FAQ sections without requiring developer intervention.
